description: This file defines data models for representing a graph structure, including nodes, edges, and metadata, using Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: NodeModel
classes.description: Represents a node in the graph with attributes such as id, label, type, annotations, and optional color.

classes.name: EdgeModel
classes.description: Represents a directed edge in the graph with attributes like id, source, target, label, and type.

classes.name: GraphMeta
classes.description: Contains metadata about the graph, including source, creation timestamp, and tags.

classes.name: GraphModel
classes.description: Main schema encapsulating the entire graph, including nodes, edges, and metadata.

classes.name: GraphModelCreate
classes.description: Input model for creating or updating a graph, similar to GraphModel but with an optional id.
